subject: Thank you for volunteering at Essência
message:
Hey {{name}},

Thank you for supporting us at Essência until {{departure}}! Your time and energy meant a lot to us and to everyone here.

We hope you had a good time and take lots of good memories with you. If you would like to tell us how it was for you, we would love to hear it. Your words help us grow:
{{feedbackLink}}

Or just reply to this email, we read every message.

You are always welcome back.

Com carinho,
Your Essência Community
